_source: Sampled by `bun packages/ui-mac/test-fixtures/engine-adapter-sampler/sample.ts` (alpha-code#1668 L6) at cc7f49a66b: a real OpenCode 2 engine from this repo's packages/cli `serve`, isolated HOME/XDG, one git project, and the scripted OpenAI-compatible mock model next to the sampler. Turn 1 `read a.txt please`; turn 2 is the timeline's Continue sent through the adapter (POST /session/:id/prompt_async, one synthetic text part), whose mock call writes c.txt. Records carry the message page after each frame and, at step / execution boundaries, `diff` = GET /api/session/:id/diff?from=<that turn's user message>. `legacy` = the same continuation as a 2.x synthetic message, and the diff asked with it as `from`.
